# Midnight BiS Tracker

> World of Warcraft Best in Slot gear tracking web app

## What this tool does
- Tracks Best in Slot (BiS) gear for all 40 WoW specs
- Imports current gear via SimulationCraft (/simc) paste
- Analyzes stat priorities and flags suboptimal gear
- Shows farming priority per dungeon based on gear gaps
- Supports catalog mode for browsing BiS lists without SimC
- Free, open-source, no login required

## How to use
1. Open the tracker and select your spec
2. Type /simc in World of Warcraft and copy the output
3. Paste into the tracker's import field
4. View your BiS gaps, alt items, and dungeon farming priorities

## Supported content
- All 13 WoW classes, all 40 specializations
- Midnight Season 1 dungeon and raid BiS lists
- Item grade system: Veteran / Champion / Hero / Myth
